title: Zero-Inset Tactile Dialogs & Shadow Elimination (v0.4.6)
message: Polished GabAI with eliminated Material3 button shadows, zero-inset tactile action buttons, and refined dialog boundaries.
changelog:
• Eliminated Cheap Button Shadows: Stripped Material3 default elevation shadows and stateListAnimator artifacts
• Zero-Inset Tactile Dialogs: Disabled default vertical insets for clean, flush touch targets
• Slate-Defined Secondary Buttons: Crisp 1.5dp border stroke and high-contrast Slate-700 typography
• Universal Dialog Refinement: Consistent tactile response across confirmation, input, QR, and class management modals
